"""Model of a line-sensitive test where line position is the product contract."""

from comet.config import parse_config


def test_parser_reports_the_line_of_invalid_input() -> None:
    """Require the parser diagnostic to report the invalid input line."""
    diagnostic = parse_config("[section\nkey = value\nbroken")
    assert diagnostic.line == 3
    assert diagnostic.column == 7
